DISCOVERY 610, THE COURT ADOPTED THE TENTATIVE RULING WITH MODIFICATION. DEFENDANT'S MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS IS GRANTED IN PART AND DENIED IN PART. AS TO REQUEST #12, THE MOTION IS GRANTED TO THE EXTENT THAT PLAINTIFF MAY REDACT INFORMATION THAT DOES NOT RELATE TO DEPOSITS. AS TO REQUEST #17, THE MOTION IS GRANTED. IF PLAINTIFF HAS PROVIDED ALL DOCUMENTS IN HER CUSTODY OR CONTROL, SAID REPRESENTATION SHALL BE VERIFIED. PRODUCTION OF RESPONSIVE DOCUMENTS SHALL BE COMPLETED WITHIN15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER.
